name: is-gpt-nerfed
description: Transparent, user-controlled detection of silent model downgrades in Codex sessions: a zero-token passive scan of the session rollout on every turn, plus ModelTrace fingerprint probes run in ephemeral forks of the thread (the mechanism behind /side) on a schedule you choose. Verdicts are delivered as a snarky card.

hooks.description: is-gpt-nerfed: passive session-integrity scan, probe scheduling, verdict delivery, optional halt

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; S="$P/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || S="$HOME/.codex/is-gpt-nerfed/plugin/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$S" hook --event SessionStart'

sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; S="$P/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || S="$HOME/.codex/is-gpt-nerfed/plugin/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$S" hook --event UserPromptSubmit'

sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; S="$P/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || S="$HOME/.codex/is-gpt-nerfed/plugin/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$S" hook --event PreToolUse'

sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; S="$P/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || S="$HOME/.codex/is-gpt-nerfed/plugin/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$S" hook --event Stop'
hooks.statusMessage: is-gpt-nerfed: scanning session for silent downgrades

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; S="$P/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || S="$HOME/.codex/is-gpt-nerfed/plugin/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/nerfed"; [ -f "$S" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$S" hook --event SessionEnd'

interface.shortDescription: Catch silent model downgrades in your Codex sessions
interface.longDescription: is-gpt-nerfed watches every Codex session for silent model, reasoning-effort and context-window changes (zero tokens), and on a schedule you choose forks the thread ephemerally to run ModelTrace fingerprint probes that attribute the answering model. Results arrive as a card, a macOS notification and a message in the thread. Everything stays on your machine. Fingerprint bank and scorer: github.com/xqy2006/ModelTrace (MIT).
defaultPrompt: Did Codex silently downgrade this session? Use $is-gpt-nerfed.
